Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Blackrock (BLK) Position Boosted by Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co; Dalton Investments Has Raised Its Genpact Limited (G) Stake by $1.74 Million 
March 17, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Sharlyn C. Heslam increased its stake in Blackrock Inc (BLK) by 3.78% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co bought 1,487 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.17% with the market. The hedge fund run by Sharlyn C. Heslam held 40,835 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $18.26 million, up from 39,348 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co who had been investing in Blackrock Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $91.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $5.73 during the last trading session, reaching $563.66. About 616,887 shares traded or 2.30% up from the average. BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) has risen 12.19% since March 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.51% the S&P500. 
Gifford Combs increased its stake in Genpact Limited (G) by 7.4% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dalton Investments Llc bought 62,159 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.60% with the market. The hedge fund run by Gifford Combs held 902,119 shares of the professional services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $25.94M, up from 839,960 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dalton Investments Llc who had been investing in Genpact Limited for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.94% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $32.6. About 1.04M shares traded or 26.45% up from the average. Genpact Limited (NYSE:G) has declined 1.49% since March 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.19% the S&P500. 
Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co, which manages about $853.26M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ishares (SHY) by 24,075 shares to 27,989 shares, valued at $2.36 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,347 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 165,717 shares, and cut its stake in Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW).
